builds.speed: 20 ft. even in medium or heavy armor
builds.title: Arctic Dwarf glacier guide, Ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +1, size +1. Touch 12, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty 0. BAB +1, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +3, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Land speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework and a reactive check within 10 ft. An Arctic Dwarf can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+2 racial bonus on saves against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
Immune to cold. AC 18 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC.

Favored enemy giants gives +2 weapon damage and +2 on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks used against giants. Alertness gives +2 to Listen and Spot, already included in the listed skills.
Track is a bonus feat. Wild empathy +0 on a 1d20 check. May use it on magical beasts with Intelligence 1 or 2 at −4.
actions: Small quarterstaff +6 melee, 1d4+6 bludgeoning when striking with one end in two hands, critical ×2. Small sling +3 ranged, 1d3+4 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 50-ft. range increment. Add +1 to either attack against orcs and goblinoids. Add +2 to damage against giants.
Track using Survival +5, or +7 against giants. Listen +9 and Spot +9 against giants.
builds.tactics: Irsa stops at the far end of the ice shelf to identify the tracks before the party follows. She keeps the rope ready when the route crosses cracked ice.

builds.speed: 20 ft. even in medium or heavy armor
builds.title: Arctic Dwarf pass guard, Fighter 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 4 (2 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral. Chainmail +5, heavy wooden shield +2, size +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 18, armor check penalty −7. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +6, Reflex +0, Will +1.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip while firmly grounded. Land speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework and a reactive check within 10 ft. An Arctic Dwarf can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+2 racial bonus on saves against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
Immune to cold. AC 22 against giants while eligible for a Dexterity bonus to AC. Improved Initiative adds +4 and Weapon Focus adds +1 to heavy pick attacks.
Power Attack trades up to 2 points of melee attack bonus for an equal damage bonus with the one-handed heavy pick.
actions: Small heavy pick +9 melee, 1d4+5 piercing, critical ×4. With full Power Attack, +7 melee, 1d4+7 piercing.
Small shortspear +3 ranged, 1d4+5 piercing, critical ×2, 20-ft. range increment. Add +1 to either weapon’s attack against orcs and goblinoids.
builds.tactics: Merec blocks the narrow approach while others secure the guide rope. He keeps his distance from any creature large enough to reach across the ridge.

concepts.name: Irsa Whitecurl
concepts.motive: Find a path that keeps the rescue party away from the unstable shelf.
concepts.hook: Irsa points to the tracks across the ice and asks the party to wait while she checks the crossing.

concepts.name: Merec Iceknot
concepts.motive: Keep the pass open while the last sled reaches camp.
concepts.hook: Merec asks for a second lookout after a rockfall exposes the flank of his post.
